entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Safavid Empire, a political institution in Iran during Safavid Empire (1501–1524). Grew from Shah Ismail I conquers Tabriz and declares Twelver Shiism the state religion. Led to the emergence of Battle of Chaldiran — Ottoman victory establishes the Safavid-Ottoman frontier and Shah Abbas I moves the capital to Isfahan and builds Naqsh-e Jahan Square.
